description: Count full-time equivalent employees (FTE) from full-time staff and groups of part-time staff, and run the Affordable Care Act count that decides whether an employer has 50 or more full-time equivalents. Use it for workforce planning, headcount reporting or checking applicable-large-employer status. FTE is total weekly hours divided by the hours of one full-time schedule; the ACA count uses the IRS rule (30 hours a week is full-time, other employees count their monthly hours up to 120 each, divided by 120). Returns both counts; assumes every month looks like the one entered.

full_time_hours_per_week.description: Weekly hours of one full-time schedule at your company. Default 40.

part_time_groups.description: Up to 6 groups of part-time staff, each with a head count and weekly hours per person. Leave empty if there are none.

hours_per_week.description: Hours each person in the group works per week.

name: fte_calculator

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.
